meta.note: Follow up drip for Sun Facing Checker leads. api/sun-facing.js posts here (best effort, never blocks the response) whenever someone emails themselves a sun summary. Waits 2 days, then sends a plain text email pointing to the buyers guide and Winfred's WhatsApp/Calendly links. No advice, no hyphens. Import into n8n, pick an SMTP or Gmail credential on the 'Send viewing checklist email' node, then activate.

name: Sun Facing Checker follow up drip

parameters.subject: Your viewing checklist
parameters.text:
={{ 'Hi,

Thanks for checking the sun facing' + ($json.body.address ? ' for ' + $json.body.address : '') + ' on the Sun Facing Checker.

Here is your viewing checklist, so you can look at any unit with a clear head:
https://winfredquek.com/buyers-guide

If it is useful to talk it through, message me on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/6581618149) or book a free 30 minute call on my calendar (https://calendly.com/winfredquekoc).

Winfred Quek' }}
